paper_title: A Generative-AI-Driven Claim Retrieval System Capable of Detecting and   Retrieving Claims from Social Media Platforms in Multiple Languages
caption: Number of participants (N=6) who highlighted each evaluation criterion as beneficial.
model_annotation: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of participants (N=6) who highlighted each evaluation criterion as beneficial, with the criteria listed along the vertical axis labeled "Criterion" and the number of participants shown along the horizontal axis labeled "Number of Participants," which uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6 with tick marks at intervals of 2. The bar labeled "Relevant FCs" is the longest, colored dark purple, and extends to the value 6, indicating all six participants found it beneficial. The bar labeled "FC Summary," colored dark blue, extends to the value 5, indicating five participants found it beneficial. The bars labeled "Relevance Explanation" and "Clarity and Simplicity," both colored teal, extend to the value 3, indicating three participants found each beneficial. The bar labeled "Overall Summary," colored green, extends to the value 2, indicating two participants found it beneficial. The bars labeled "Filters" and "Veracity Explanation," both colored olive green, extend to the value 1, indicating one participant found each beneficial. The bars are arranged in descending order of participant count, with no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding applied to any individual bar.
